comment: Single populated 14x11 stripboard (buffer/booster) with values printed on every part; D1-D2 are given only as Germanium. The DPDT footswitch is wired to Gain 1 and the board (Switch 1/2), so it is listed as the boost control rather than a bypass.
uncertain: Switch: legend says only 'DPDT footswitch'; listed as an effect control because it connects to Gain 1 on the board, but it may be the pedal's only footswitch
